report.speaker: Jérôme Buzzi
report.title: Chaos on Surfaces and Beyond: A New Notion of Dynamical Hyperbolicity
report.outline_title: 从高熵双曲块到混沌的统计规律
report.version_role: Official published ICM2026 Volume 5: Invited Lectures (Sections 9-11), online 2026-07-13. The official full HTML is the report source; the 97-page BCS preprint is supplementary and pinned to v1.
report.copyright: Copyright 2026 International Mathematical Union, published by SIAM under CC BY 4.0, verified in official publication metadata. The reference attributes the Chinese adaptation and added calculations. This license does not extend to the cited nonexclusive-license arXiv manuscript.
report.question: How does common positive mass on controlled hyperbolic blocks prevent high-entropy escape, produce finite ergodic maximal-entropy structure and quantitative statistics, and extend beyond positive-entropy smooth surfaces?
report.reading_scope: Read the complete official mathematical HTML: sections 1.1-1.2, 2.1-2.6, 3.1-3.4, 4.1-4.3, 5.1-5.2, 6.1-6.2, 7.1-7.5; all displayed statements and survey proof arguments, Questions 3.9 and 7.1-7.11, footnotes 1-2, bibliography 1-67, Figure 1 caption, publication and license metadata. No visual inspection of Figure 1 or official PDF/source TeX is claimed. BCS was read only in the targeted ranges below, not all 97 pages.
report.coverage_status: 46 atomic knowledge pages (3301-330Z; 3310-3316; 331C-331F), narrative 3300 and reference icm2026-buzzi. Main proof/construction/statistics branches are represented. Announced discretized-flow work, the uncoded-geometric-proof program, stronger thresholds, zeta continuation, flow and noncompact extensions are covered narratively with source/status boundaries, not expanded into unverified theorems.

proof_scope.3301: Defines separated-orbit entropy and proves compatible-metric invariance by uniform continuity. Conjugacy invariance follows from the same comparison.
proof_scope.3302: Defines top entropy on invariant Borel sets and ergodic MME; delegates entropy decomposition and the variational principle to separate atoms.
proof_scope.3303: Complete compactness and upper-semicontinuity proof of existence, including invariance of the limit and selection of an ergodic component. Newhouse upper semicontinuity is cited.
proof_scope.3304: Defines standard Pesin blocks and proves the shifted-block inclusion. Compactness is cited from the block lemma; splitting uniqueness is proved in 3305.
proof_scope.3305: Complete forward/backward bounded-vector proof of splitting uniqueness, with epsilon<chi used in the expansion lower bound.
proof_scope.3306: Defines pointwise, chi-hyperbolic, saddle and stable-index notions. Pesin-block exhaustion of a chi-hyperbolic measure is cited.
proof_scope.3307: States Pesin stable-manifold theorem for r>1 and hyperbolic invariant measures; distinguishes it from the existing uniform theorem. Graph-transform construction remains external.
proof_scope.3308: Complete two-sided Ruelle derivation of lambda1>=h>0>-h>=lambda2 for ergodic surface measures; does not use the area-preserving Pesin equality.
proof_scope.3309: Defines SPR with fixed chi, then arbitrary epsilon, then common threshold/block/mass, then all high-entropy ergodic measures. Proves the uniform-hyperbolic example.
proof_scope.3310: Cites the local quadratic large-deviation bound with positive variance and explicit quantifier order. Conservatively specializes to period one; no uniform moving-threshold result is inferred.
proof_scope.3311: Cites square-root entropy-gap control for positive exponent sum on a single SPR class, and separately the unique-global-MME surface result. Only direct substitution consequences are calculated.
proof_scope.3312: Complete one-dimensional derivative multiplicativity and Birkhoff proof of average-exponent continuity; warns that positive-part integration needs additional sign control.
proof_scope.3313: Cites the report's accessible T3 circle-fibration dichotomy and SPR equivalence. Separately states the C2 closed-connected-three-manifold sufficient condition actually present in BCS v1, retaining bounded center-leaf length and a hyperbolic periodic point.
proof_scope.3314: Defines pressure, equilibrium state and potential-SPR with finite real top pressure. Cites BCS Theorem G only for Holder potentials on a Borel homoclinic class.
proof_scope.3315: Defines unstable-Jacobian potential and reuses the atomic SRB definition 380K; retains sufficient-condition question as open at the report's scope. Does not assert that every hyperbolic SRB measure is SPR.
proof_scope.3316: Defines symmetric asymptotic derivative dilation and proves its limit exists by subadditivity. Cites the strict finite-Cr entropy threshold for global or class SPR; derives impossibility of SPR plus infinitely many ergodic MME at r>1.
proof_scope.330A: Complete positive-block-mass and Oseledets argument for |lambda_i|>=chi; strict chi'-hyperbolicity uses chi'<chi.
proof_scope.330B: Defines positive exponent sum by integral of pointwise positive parts, proves the Jacobian integral identity using Oseledets and dominated convergence, and explains nonergodic cancellation.
proof_scope.330C: Complete subadditive-integral infimum formula and weak upper-semicontinuity proof, using Oseledets as a cited input.
proof_scope.330D: Cites the positive entropy/exponent loss decomposition. Completely derives maximal-entropy exponent continuity, including the subsequence argument and beta=1.
proof_scope.330E: States EH/EC criterion in positive-entropy global or Borel-homoclinic-class setting. Forward implication is C1; converse is retained at C1+. Stable index is constant within each limit, not necessarily across all limits.
proof_scope.330F: Complete deduction of smooth positive-entropy surface SPR from Newhouse, Ruelle, entropy decomposition, exponent continuity and the criterion. The input research theorems remain cited.
proof_scope.330G: Complete neutral-vector obstruction to every Pesin block for Anosov times circle rotation. Positive entropy of the cat map is a standard cited example.
proof_scope.330H: Defines double transverse homoclinic relation and proves equality of stable dimensions. Equivalence relation and periodic representative are cited.
proof_scope.330I: Defines Borel homoclinic representatives, class entropy and period. Existence, separation and measure-class correspondence are cited, not reconstructed.
proof_scope.330J: Defines countable graph shifts and regular part; proves every invariant probability gives full mass to the regular part using the existing Poincare recurrence theorem.
proof_scope.330K: Complete path-modulo-period construction, equality of cyclic masses, nonmixing obstruction, and independence of base vertex.
proof_scope.330L: Defines finite-core symbolic SPR and escape entropy; gives a complete diagonal proof of equivalence with a strict entropy gap. Equivalence to loop growth is cited.
proof_scope.330M: Cites Gurevich variational principle and SPR loop-growth characterization. Gives the renewal generating-function proof of F(R)>1 iff the first-return radius exceeds the loop radius.
proof_scope.330N: Defines Bernoulli times a finite cycle; proves block coding of the pth power, phase obstruction to mixing, and equivalence of total ergodicity with period one in this class.
proof_scope.330O: Cites existence/uniqueness and Bernoulli-up-to-period for finite-entropy irreducible SPR shifts, and the homoclinic-class version. Does not infer these from arbitrary finite-to-one maps alone.
proof_scope.330P: States coding with domain Sigma, finite fibers only on Sigma#, entropy-preserving projection and lifting of chi-hyperbolic ergodic measures. SPR transfer requires coding chi below the SPR constant.
proof_scope.330Q: Cites the global finite-homoclinic-class decomposition; explains its local-product mechanism without calling it a full proof. Fully proves finite-class-to-global SPR combination and derives finiteness of ergodic MME.
proof_scope.330R: Complete h-transform normalization, duality, invariance and L1 contraction calculation under stated spectral eigen-data; full-shift L1=q versus normalized L1=1 check. Existence of eigen-data remains cited.
proof_scope.330S: Complete abstract spectral-gap-to-correlation estimate with explicit continuous embedding into L1; spectrum/radius formula and existence of the SPR Banach space are cited inputs.
proof_scope.330T: Cites exponential mixing for the MME of an SPR class with total ergodicity/period one and Holder norms. Retains the cyclic-component f^p version when p>1.
proof_scope.330U: Cites positive-entropy class equivalence involving an MME, common exponent gap and exponential entrance tails. Explicitly quantifies C after epsilon. Derives the surface simplification from Ruelle.
proof_scope.330V: Complete tail-sum proof that a nonnegative integer entrance time has exponential tails iff some positive exponential moment is finite, and all polynomial moment bounds.
proof_scope.330W: Complete Green-Kubo expansion and absolute-summability limit proof. States the ordinary formula only under summable correlations; does not use it unmodified for period p>1.
proof_scope.330X: Cites zero-variance equivalence with periodic averages and measurable coboundaries for the SPR-class MME. Gives a full telescoping proof only for the additional L2-coboundary case.
proof_scope.330Y: Defines process-level ASIP coupling and completely derives the central limit consequence by distribution-function bounds; treats sigma=0 separately and obtains parameter uniqueness.
proof_scope.330Z: Cites ASIP with SPR class, MME and centered Holder observable, rates gamma in (1/4,1/2). No period-one requirement is added. General quasi-Holder extension is mentioned only as scope of the source.
proof_scope.331C: Defines Holder seminorm/norm and gives the complete exponent-product calculation for pullback by a Holder coding.
proof_scope.331D: States compact continuous variational principle as a standard cited theorem; derives restriction of the supremum to ergodic measures from 331E.
proof_scope.331E: States standard ergodic decomposition and entropy integral formula as cited theorems; fully proves the maximality and support consequences by integrating nonnegative functions.
proof_scope.331F: States Ruelle-Margulis inequality for C1 closed-manifold diffeomorphisms and arbitrary invariant probabilities; records the inverse-time inequality and distinguishes it from the Pesin equality.

remaining_branches: Deep research proofs remain cited: Newhouse, Pesin/Ruelle, exponent-loss decomposition and EH/EC criterion, homoclinic representatives and coding, SPR symbolic structure, spectral-gap construction, exponential mixing/entrance characterization, periodic-obstruction theorem, ASIP/LDP and entropy-gap estimates.

General quasi-Holder observables and all geometric potentials are not developed. Holder statements are retained. Ordinary Green-Kubo is proved only with absolute correlation summability, not asserted for arbitrary periodic systems.

Uniform hyperbolicity and structural-stability history, Young tower constructions and a detailed C-infinity nonuniform example are context only; no duplicate foundational pages or new full proofs are claimed.

The report's continuous-potential/unique-positive-entropy-equilibrium argument is not expanded into a separate proof. The potential-SPR definition and Holder-class theorem are included; specialized mostly contracting/expanding SRB constructions remain cited context.
Announced discretized-Anosov-flow dichotomy appears only with in-preparation status in 3300/reference. No public manuscript proof is claimed.

Questions about abundance, uncoded geometric proofs, epsilon-independent thresholds, geometric entropy at infinity, filtered zeta continuation, flows and noncompact manifolds remain questions. No later literature resolution is claimed.

Burguet periodic-count growth was not independently checked in the original full paper. The report's all-n limit is not repeated: cyclic periods require care. The outline discusses only the corrected z^n/n-weighted zeta question without a new all-n growth theorem.
Official Problem 7.3 is not reproduced as a viable r>1 construction: SPR plus infinitely many ergodic MME conflicts with the cited C1+ finite-MME theorem. The C1 endpoint is not resolved.
normalization_notes: Date 2026-10-19; author{author}; native Forester math wrappers; no raw wiki links or negative thin spaces.
MME means ergodic MME when discussing finiteness. Convex combinations are not counted as additional ergodic MME.
SPR quantifiers: fixed chi; for every epsilon in (0,chi), a common threshold h0, block C and positive mass; then all high-entropy ergodic measures.
Pointwise positive exponent parts are integrated before averaging; same-index hypotheses are stated locally.
Class coding threshold chi is chosen below the SPR exponent constant; finite fibers are restricted to Sigma#.
Probability transfer operator is the normalized h-transform, not the unweighted Ruelle sum.
Exponential mixing retains total ergodicity/period-one; ASIP does not require period one.
Entrance time starts at n=0, inf empty=+infinity; C is quantified after epsilon.
Finite-Cr threshold uses the symmetric asymptotic derivative dilation from BCS (1.2), not an ambiguously named single-step Lipschitz exponent.
Parent owns final normalizeFormat, shared audit registration, integration, global checks/build and browser validation.
